# Live batch: estimated at $18.00 per month (EXPECTED)

The scheduled batch job comes to about **$18.00 a month**, or **$216 a year**. That is $216 for the first year too, because there are no one-time costs. The input check returned READY and the calculation is complete with no pending items. [1]

## How it was calculated
Processing, serverless jobs, recurring monthly: 20 runs × 2 hours × 1 DBU per hour = 40 DBU. At $0.45 per DBU that is $18.00. \[[2](https://fevm-classic-stable-naren.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/01f1d6efcecd1620b04cf487817675b7/chats/01f1d6f047e61d7889278ace08e1d444?o=7474644082064164&gra_focus=pub_toolu_bdrk_01WfKa3k9CDyBjSgW8NixYKZ)\]

- **Databricks cost:** $18.00 for 40 DBU.
- **AWS cost:** $0.
- **Pricing basis:** the $0.45 per DBU rate is a REFERENCE_ONLY planning rate (source: system.billing.list_prices). It is not a confirmed account rate.
- **Assumption:** the 1 DBU per hour intensity is the calculator's planning default, not a measured value.
- **Confidence:** LOW, because all of the cost rests on that planning default. If you have a measured DBU per hour, supplying it would improve the estimate.

## Scope
- **Included:** processing.
- **Not applicable:** SQL reporting, DataSync transfer, S3/KMS storage, model endpoints and one-time model jobs. These are recorded as not applicable, so they are not estimated and are not zero-cost placeholders.

This is an internal planning estimate, not an invoice or committed run rate.
